title: Unique and Beautiful Park
text: Park Guell is absolutely beautiful, and no trip to Barcelona is complete without visiting. It's more than nature, it's the Gaudi design that makes it unique. I went in November, where the crowds are smaller. Note, get a ticket in advance to go, as it does sell out, even in November. It's a hike to get there, and you will be disappointed if you don't have your ticket. And book direct with the park and save money.
